neighbours.label: a noun or verb for a university course of study (a communication major, majoring in, a journalism degree)
fire: She is a biology major at Ohio State.
Students majoring in physics must take this lab.
You can use your history degree in many careers.
He is an English major and writes for the paper.
Most of the art majors live near the studio.
He earned an accounting degree at night school.
Those majoring in French study abroad for a year.
My sister is a chemistry major at Duke.
quiet: She is a tall woman at Ohio State.
Students living in dorms must take this bus.
You can use your history book in many classes.
He is an English teacher and writes for the paper.
Most of the art students live near the studio.
He earned a small bonus at night work.
Those living in France study abroad for a year.
My sister is a nurse at Duke.

notes: Card: ' major' x12, 'j', 'leg', ' majors' x2, ' students', ' degree'. Probes: ' major' 1.022 and 0.521, ' degree' 0.606, ' courses' 0.398; 'a tall man at USC' 0.187, 'Trojans' 0.112. Near misses keep college frames without the course of study, and ' major' as an adjective is not used.
